description: Log one provenance-backed movement segment. Origin, destination, timestamps, source, and external_id are required for a deduplicated route history. ($0.10; API key required)

arrived_at.description: Arrival as ISO 8601 date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-17T15:30:00+08:00.

confidence.description: Confidence in the segment from 0 to 1, e.g. 0.9.

departed_at.description: Departure as ISO 8601 date-time with offset, e.g. 2026-10-17T14:05:00+08:00.

destination.description: Destination place name, e.g. Changi Airport.

destination_address.description: Destination street address, e.g. 60 Airport Blvd, Singapore.

external_id.description: Provider id that dedupes imports, e.g. venmo-gmail-18c2a1b.

geometry_source.description: Where route_geometry came from: observed_gps, provider_polyline, reconstructed or straight_line, e.g. observed_gps.

metadata.description: Extra provider data stored with the segment, e.g. {"trip_id":"8f31c2"}.

mode.description: Transport mode: walk, bike, car, rideshare, train, bus, ferry, flight or other, e.g. rideshare.

origin.description: Origin place name, e.g. Ferry Building.

origin_address.description: Origin street address, e.g. 1 Market St, San Francisco.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

route_geometry.description: GeoJSON LineString of the route, e.g. {"type":"LineString","coordinates":[[103.85,1.29],[103.99,1.36]]}.

source.description: Provenance of the segment, e.g. uber.

source_reference.description: Provider reference for the segment, e.g. trip 8f31c2.

name: log_movement

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.
